app.title: Show HN: Carrier-Explode: iPhone, Pixel and Galaxy carrier settings decoded
app.author: simplyalec
app.description: A command-line utility that decodes carrier configuration files from iPhone, Pixel, and Galaxy devices, extracting network settings such as APN, carrier name, and security parameters.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and run `cargo build` to ensure the binary compiles.
Execute `carrierexplode -h` to verify help output and available flags.
Provide a sample carrier settings file (e.g., `sample.cfg`) and run `carrierexplode -i sample.cfg` to confirm JSON output contains expected keys.
Measure execution time for processing 100 carrier files and compare against a baseline implementation.
